sql.question: How much did I spend in total?
sql.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(my_share), 0) AS total_spent FROM analytics.my_expenses LIMIT 200

sql.question: How much did I spend on coffee in the last 30 days?
sql.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(my_share), 0) AS spent FROM analytics.my_expenses WHERE subcategory ILIKE '%coffee%' AND spent_on >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 DAYS' LIMIT 200

sql.question: Total spending per category, all time
sql.sql: SELECT category, SUM(my_share) AS total_spent FROM analytics.my_expenses GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 200

sql.question: How much did I spend on rent overall?
sql.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(my_share), 0) AS total_spent FROM analytics.my_expenses WHERE category ILIKE 'Rent' LIMIT 200

sql.question: How many expenses did I pay for myself?
sql.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM analytics.my_expenses WHERE paid_by_me = TRUE LIMIT 200

sql.question: What is the largest single share I had in any expense?
sql.sql: SELECT MAX(my_share) AS largest_share FROM analytics.my_expenses LIMIT 200

sql.question: How much did I spend in the Goa Trip group?
sql.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(my_share), 0) AS spent FROM analytics.my_expenses WHERE group_name ILIKE '%goa trip%' LIMIT 200

sql.question: How many expenses have I shared with Rahul Sharma?
sql.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT expense_id) AS shared_expenses FROM analytics.my_expense_people WHERE person_name ILIKE 'Rahul Sharma' AND NOT is_me LIMIT 200

sql.question: How much have I received in settlements?
sql.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS received FROM analytics.my_settlements WHERE direction = 'received' LIMIT 200

sql.question: Average share of my Food expenses
sql.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(my_share) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_food_share FROM analytics.my_expenses WHERE category = 'Food' LIMIT 200

sql.question: How much did Rahul Sharma pay for expenses I was part of?
sql.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_paid_by_rahul FROM analytics.my_expenses WHERE paid_by_name ILIKE '%Rahul Sharma%' LIMIT 200

sql.question: Which items on my receipts cost more than 300?
sql.sql: SELECT receipt_id AS "Receipt ID", merchant AS "Merchant", item_name AS "Item", amount AS "Amount" FROM analytics.my_receipt_items WHERE amount > 300 LIMIT 200
